map.由需求与保费变动率求弹性 使用指南: Elasticity from Demand and Premium Change Rates User Guide
map.输入保险需求量的变动率与保费的变动率，按弹性 = (%Δ需求)/(%Δ保费) 计: Enter the change rate of demand volume and the change rate of the premium, and compute demand price elasticity as elasticity = (%change in demand)/(%change in premium), to analyze how a rate adjustment affects willingness to buy.
map.弹性 = (Δ需求/需求)/(Δ保费/保费): Elasticity = (change in demand / demand) / (change in premium / premium)
map.输入需求量变动率与保费变动率，求需求弹性。: Enter the demand change rate and the premium change rate to get demand elasticity.
map.看保费涨 1% 需求降多少，判断提价空间。: See how much demand falls when the premium rises 1%, to judge pricing room.
map.做定价策略的敏感性分析。: Run sensitivity analysis for pricing strategy.
map.：弹性 = (−10%)/(+20%) = −0.5。绝对值<1 缺乏弹性，提价: Elasticity = (-10%)/(+20%) = -0.5. With an absolute value below 1 the demand is inelastic, so raising the premium still increases total premium income.

map.弹性负号怎么读？: How Do You Read the Negative Sign of Elasticity?
map.需求与保费反向，弹性为负；看绝对值。|E|<1 可提价增收入，|E|>1 应降价: Demand and premium move in opposite directions, so elasticity is negative; look at the absolute value. With |E| < 1 you can raise price and revenue, while |E| > 1 calls for a price cut to win volume.
map.弹性大对保险公司是好事吗？: Is High Elasticity Good for the Insurer?
map.中性偏风险。弹性大说明客户对价格敏感、易流失，小幅涨价就丢量；但降价也易冲量。定: Neutral leaning toward risk. High elasticity means customers are price-sensitive and easy to lose, so a small price rise loses volume; but price cuts also pull volume easily. Pricing should find the profit-maximizing point between price and volume rather than simply raising price.
